faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We answer all your questions about the real estate market.

items.q: What is the first step to sell my property?
items.a: The first step is a free professional appraisal. Our expert team will visit your property to carry out a detailed market study and advise you on the optimal asking price.

items.q: What do I need to prepare for the sale?
items.a: You will need the owners' ID (DNI), the Property Deed, the latest IBI receipt, the Energy Efficiency Certificate, and the Habitability Certificate (if applicable). We help you process whatever you are missing.

items.q: How long does it take on average to sell a home?
items.a: The time varies depending on the price and condition, but our average sale time is between 3 and 6 months thanks to our active buyer database and specialized marketing.

items.q: How do you promote my property to find buyers?
items.a: We use a multi-channel approach: leading real estate portals, social networks, our physical showcase, and our extensive network of local contacts.
Our fees are competitive and transparent. They are agreed upon in advance and only paid at the time of sale before a notary. There are no hidden costs or maintenance fees.

items.q: Do you accompany me during the signing before a notary?
items.a: Absolutely. We accompany you from the first visit to the signing of the public deed and the change of utility supplies. Your peace of mind is our priority.

items.q: Do you also manage the Energy Efficiency Certificate?
items.a: Yes, we collaborate with authorized technicians to manage your energy certificate quickly and easily so you don't have to worry about anything.

items.q: Do you have experience in managing inheritances and rustic properties?
items.a: Yes, we are specialists in managing a wide range of properties. We understand the complexity of rustic properties and inheritances, and we work with local experts to ensure that everything is legal and transparent.

items.q: Do you offer secure rental services?
items.a: Yes, we manage rentals with rigorous tenant filtering and non-payment insurance to guarantee the security of your investment and your peace of mind as an owner.

items.q: Why choose us over a large national franchise?
items.a: Because we are local experts. We know every street and every neighborhood personally. We offer human treatment, without pressure, and with the transparency that only someone you trust can give you.
